phrase_inventory: User-selected nonempty distinct phrases; no fixed phrase-count cap
allocation: Every phrase visits every accepted Train reference once when its target equals the reference-bank size

compatibility.allowed: Unstarted Hard generation with the current scale's reference-bank size; no live worker or Final lock
compatibility.blocked: Existing Hard contract, candidates, completed Hard stage, training output, or changed computational file outside this release pair
compatibility.before_snapshot: Every migration preserves workflow_before.json and its SHA-256
compatibility.execution: Migration does not start workers or submit phrase approval

validation: Hard v1/v2 generation, full phrase/reference Cartesian coverage, resume and immutable contract checks
Synthetic pool admission v1/v2 and tampered count/slot/seed rejection
Studio preset totals, legacy totals, waiting-input migration and started-generation rejection
CLI per-phrase/legacy dispatch and mutually exclusive arguments
UI live totals, more than 32 phrases, input preservation and unresolved storage accounting
performance_claim: Engineering defaults, not a validated Korean optimum or a population performance claim
